relationships.subject: LPS
relationships.evidence_quote: LPS binds to the toll-like receptor (TLR) 4 and promotes production of cytokines through a number of different signaling pathways including MAPK pathways.

key_findings: CB2 agonist ABK5-1 cut LPS-induced sICAM1, IL-6 and RANTES by >50% in BV-2 microglia and reduced ERK phosphorylation.
ABK5-1 did not change LPS-induced TNF-alpha release.
